notes: Estimate with Gemini: Dawni now picks the best model your API key supports and tries another if one is busy, so estimates keep working as Google changes models.
Settings: new Test key button on the Gemini card. It's free, and it shows which model Dawni will use.
Gemini setup problems now explain what to fix — an invalid key, or the Generative Language API not being enabled — instead of failing quietly.
Food log: entries created from an AI estimate are labelled Estimated, so you can tell them apart from numbers you read off a label.
Updates: Dawni checks for a new version when you reopen it from your home screen, and the update card now shows the version you're moving to.
maintenanceNote: Generated by scripts/prebuild.mjs from package.json and src/release-notes.json. Bump the 4-part "version" in package.json by hand (npm version cannot parse it), edit src/release-notes.json, then npm run build.
